hero.title: Leads Come In. Revenue Comes Out.
hero.description: Form submission → AI-generated nurture sequence → SMS and email → booking or sale. Psychology-backed, consent-first, and smart enough to stop when the lead responds.

body: When a form submission arrives, leads automatically flow into AI-generated nurture sequences. All content follows a proven four-step persuasion framework: personalization, authority with specific numbers, a quantified offer with risk reversal, and a specific call to action. Funnels auto-stop when the lead replies, reaches a terminal CRM stage, or unsubscribes — preventing over-contact. Email and SMS sends are gated by explicit consent, with STOP keywords revoking globally.

sequence.label: Nurture Sequence

step2.label: Instant: Welcome SMS
step2.message: "Hi Sarah, thanks for your inquiry about our HVAC services! I'm Mike from Henderson..."

step3.label: Email: Authority + proof
step3.message: "Subject: 94% of our customers save $200+ on energy bills..."

step4.label: SMS: Offer + CTA
step4.message: "Spring special: $99 AC tune-up (regular $149). Book before Friday → habos.app/s/henderson-ac"

autostop.label: Auto-stop
autostop.desc: Lead replied / booked / won → sequence stops automatically

sequence.summary: 4-step persuasion framework: Personalization → Authority → Offer → CTA. 7 preset strategies ready to deploy.

benefits.title: Consent-first
benefits.desc: Email and SMS gated by explicit consent. STOP keywords revoke globally. First operational message has legal safe harbor — follow-ups require opt-in.

benefits.title: Smart stop rules
benefits.desc: Funnels auto-stop when the lead replies (SMS or email), reaches a terminal CRM stage (won/lost/booked), or unsubscribes. No over-contacting.

benefits.title: 7 strategies built in
benefits.desc: Warm lead follow-up, cold B2B outreach, form nurture, booking reminders, reactivation, customer upsell, and custom. Each fine-tuned for its use case.

without.label: Without HABOS
without.text: Lead fills out form. You see it 3 hours later. Draft an email. Send it. Wait. Follow up manually. Forget about 40% of leads.

with.label: With HABOS
with.text: Lead fills out form. Instant welcome SMS. Authority email 2 hours later. Offer next day. If they reply or book — sequence stops.

cta.heading: Other automation tools send messages. HABOS nurtures relationships.
